ComputerUse.custom_action_screen.title: Custom AI Screen Operation
ComputerUse.custom_action_screen.comment: Use vision model to analyze the screen and execute GUI automation task: @{instruction}

instruction.title: User Instruction
instruction.tip: Describe the GUI automation task to execute, e.g. "Open calculator and calculate 123+456"

max_steps.title: Max Execution Steps
max_steps.tip: Maximum number of steps for task execution, prevents infinite loops

computer_use_res.title: Execution Result
computer_use_res.tip: A dict containing task execution status, steps, elapsed time, screenshot directory, and error info
